    "web",
    "mobile"
  ],
  "access": {
    "visibility": "public",

    "title": "Katalog proizvoda",

  },
  "regions": {
    "main": [
      {
        "instanceKey": "catalog-main",
        "componentKey": "product-list",
        "settings": {
          "title": "Proizvodi",
          "layout": "grid",
          "columns-desktop": 4,
          "columns-tablet": 2,
          "columns-mobile": 1,
          "show-brand": true,
          "show-category": true,
          "show-stock": true,
          "image-ratio": "1/1",

          "show-discount-badge": true,
          "detail-url": "/proizvod",
          "show-catalog-search": true,
          "show-category-select": true,
          "price-filter-mode": "slider-inputs",
          "show-tag-badges": true,
          "badge-tags": "Akcija,Novo",
          "badge-position": "top-start",
          "show-list-description": true,
          "filters-collapsed": false,
          "open-filters": ""
        },
        "providerInput": {
          "category": "all",
          "page": 1,
          "limit": 24,
          "sort": "default",
          "filters": [],
          "attributes": []
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
